about.title: About this app
about.intro: This is an English mirror of qlist.ir, an Iranian consumer-activism project that lists multinational brands it says have economic ties to Israel. The data — companies, sub-brands, and source dossiers — is pulled directly from qlist.ir's public Directus API and re-presented here with English labels and a barcode scanner on top.
about.stanceBody: We do not assert these claims in our own voice. Every flagged entry is attributed to qlist.ir, and where available we link directly to qlist.ir's source dossier (which cites Western reporting from outlets like The Guardian, The Independent, and Middle East Monitor). Use this app as a starting point for your own research, not as the last word.
about.scopeBody: We mirror qlist.ir's list of companies it flags for Israel-related ties. We do not reproduce qlist.ir's separate "American-owned" boycott category — that is a political stance specific to the Iranian movement and isn't reproduced here.
